evals.prompt: Help me write a userscript for the Bilibili video page: add a 'one-click triple' button below the video that auto-likes + coins + favorites when clicked.
evals.expected_output: A userscript with a complete metadata block whose @match covers the Bilibili video page, a button injected below the video player, and every GM_* function used declared in @grant.
assertions: The output contains a complete // ==UserScript== metadata block
@match precisely matches the target site domain (no http://*/* blanket match)
The button is injected with createElement + appendChild and handles SPA re-renders (MutationObserver or re-insertion with a marker class)
Every GM API used is declared in @grant

evals.prompt: I want to rewrite every recommendation-feed title on the Zhihu homepage to 'I am a title'. Write a Tampermonkey script that hijacks the feed API and modifies the returned data.
evals.expected_output: A userscript that intercepts the recommendation feed response and rewrites title fields in the data before the page renders them.
assertions: The script hijacks the API on unsafeWindow or the page window (fetch and/or XHR), not just sandbox window
A fetch hijack keeps a reference to the original fetch and calls it with call/apply; Response.json (or text) is re-wrapped
Response data is modified after JSON parsing and before resolving

evals.prompt: The search box on this site is written in React. My script assigned a value to the input but the submit does nothing — how do I trigger its onChange?
evals.expected_output: An explanation and code that invoke the React onChange handler registered on the element (via __reactEventHandlers or the Fiber chain) instead of relying on synthetic input events.
assertions: The answer uses __reactEventHandlers/__reactFiber (or equivalent React internals) to obtain and call onChange
It does not claim that assigning value + dispatching a synthetic Event alone works on React
It accounts for isTrusted being unfalsifiable for synthetic events if relevant

evals.prompt: Write a script to remove the ads on bbs.example.com pages and speed up the video player to 2x.
evals.expected_output: A userscript targeting bbs.example.com that removes ad elements and forces the video playback rate to 2.
assertions: The script targets only bbs.example.com via @match
Ad removal handles dynamically injected elements (MutationObserver, not a one-time query at page load)
Every GM API used is declared in @grant
